scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @trading/api" "npm run dev --workspace @trading/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @trading/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @trading/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @trading/api && npm run build --workspace @trading/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @trading/api
